# Vendored Three.js

Vendored from the `three@0.187.0` npm package.

- `three.module.js` and `three.core.js` are the unminified browser modules from `build/`.
- `addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js` is from `examples/jsm/` and uses a relative import to `three.module.js` for direct browser loading.
- `LICENSE` is the license distributed with the package.
